Definition: to meander (causatively, guide) about, especially for trade or reconnoitring
BiblicalUsage: tûwr is the word the Bible uses when it means to spy out, to search. In Numbers 10:33, to search out a resting place for them, and it appears again in Deuteronomy 1:33.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the searching out of the land was God's care going ahead of His people, finding their resting place.
